item.title: SEC schedules Aug. 14 vote on Reg Crypto proposal allowing token issuers to raise up to $75M without securities registration.
SEC to simultaneously vote on digital securities trading exemption that could enable 24/7 stock token trading on blockchain platforms.
DTCC completes first live production trades of tokenized equities and Treasuries with JPMorgan, BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, and Vanguard.
CFTC charges Florida man and Goliath Ventures with operating a $397M Ponzi scheme targeting more than 1,600 retail customers.
U.S. Clarity Act fails Senate procedural vote, leaving digital asset framework development to SEC and CFTC rulemaking.
SEC approves generic listing standards for spot crypto ETPs, with Bitwise projecting over 100 new crypto ETFs eligible to list.
Coldcard hardware wallet exploit costs approximately $130M as a cryptographic library flaw present since 2021 enables mass Bitcoin theft.
Harmony blockchain exploit mints 4 billion unauthorized ONE tokens, equal to over 25% of existing supply; token falls approximately 40%.
Circle receives final OCC approval to operate First National Digital Currency Bank N.A. as a federally chartered trust institution.
BNY launches USDC custody and minting services for institutional clients through expanded Circle partnership.
Morgan Stanley plans to bring crypto custody, staking, and lending services in-house at its planned digital asset trust bank.
EU's MiCA regulation fully enforced as transitional period expires; only 194 licensed crypto firms operating across the bloc.
CFTC exercises emergency authority ordering prediction market Kalshi to continue operations despite New York state lawsuit.
